title: CBIC Revises Customs Tariff Values for Gold, Silver, Edible Oils, and Brass Scrap
content:
# CBIC Revises Customs Tariff Values for Gold, Silver, Edible Oils, and Brass Scrap

Ek important update hai. Government ne gold, silver, edible oils aur brass scrap ke customs tariff values revise karne ka announce kiya hai.

CBIC (Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs) ne Notification No. 91/2026-Customs (N.T.) dated November 13, 2026, ke through in items ke tariff values ko revise kiya hai. Yeh changes November 14, 2026 se effective ho gaye hain.

**Key Revisions (effective from November 14, 2026):**

*   **Gold:** Ab US$1,245 per 10 grams value kiya jayega.
*   **Silver:** Iski value US$1,663 per kilogram set ki gayi hai.
*   **Crude Palm Oil:** Revised value US$1,141 per metric tonne hai.
*   **RBD Palm Oil:** Iska naya tariff value US$1,193 per metric tonne hoga.
*   **Crude Soya Bean Oil:** Ab US$1,282 per metric tonne par value kiya jayega.
*   **Brass Scrap (all categories):** Naya tariff value US$8,154 per metric tonne hai.

Yeh revisions Customs Act, 1962 ke Section 14(2) ke under kiye gaye hain, jisme Notification No. 36/2001-Customs (N.T.) ko amend kiya gaya hai. Is update se customs duty assessments par impact padega. Important baat yeh hai ki Areca nuts ka tariff value abhi unchanged hai.
